items.reason: UsernameForm.java:58-59 validates only the username, and PasswordForm.java:52-53 then fills user-specific WebAuthn data without checking for re-authentication. WebAuthnAuthenticator.java:98-108 supplies that user's credentials, and themes/src/main/resources/theme/base/login/passkeys.ftl:11-14 exposes their IDs, enabling unauthenticated discovery of passkey enrollment.

PasskeysUsernamePasswordFormTest.java:367-378 exercises a password failure followed by successful passkey authentication, so it does not cover the passkey-error branch at WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator.java:48-56. However, the comment only requests additional coverage; it identifies neither faulty behavior nor a test failing to verify its stated purpose.
